name: Nishant Chaudhary
title: Founder
dealName: [PARTNER] IntelliOps Automation — BD addendum (do not countersign v2)
subject: Re: Revised Business Development Agreement — four remaining items so commission is actually collectable
body:
Hi Nishant,

Thank you for the 26 August note. I have read it in full. I am glad the four remaining items are not rejected — those are the ones that decide whether a commission from Panama is actually collectable.

I will not countersign the 24 August revision as it stands, and I will not start originating against it. That is the same position as 25 August. The 20% rate is already agreed. The base, the clock, and the payment rail are not.

You asked for evidence of client-generation potential before another revision. The fastest way to get that evidence is to make the first registration collectable, not to do the origination first and reopen the contract later.

Attached is a one-page addendum to the 24 August agreement. It writes the four remaining items and a short clarification that my own practice (AIdeazz — GEO/AEO, conversational agents, and AI-ops I build and sell myself) is not a conflict under Section 16. It does not change the 20% rate or the rest of your document. If you sign it — or accept the same five clauses in a reply to this email — I will register the first overlay opportunity the same week.

To make that registration useful rather than theoretical, I still need from you: a one-page ICP, an indicative rate card or sample SOW, and the legal entity name with CIN or GSTIN on the addendum signature block.

I am interested in building this. I want the first deal to pay you, and the commission to be able to reach Panama when it does.

Best regards,
Elena Revicheva
AIdeazz AI Lab · Panama City
https://aideazz.xyz/portfolio

note:
26 Aug 2026 Nishant replied to Elena's gmail: the four remaining items are understood, not accepted; he wants BD activity first and will revise later. There is no v3 document in Zoho or Gmail (IMAP pull 4 Sep, 7 messages, 2 PDFs — v1 20 Aug and v2 24 Aug only).

Do NOT countersign v2. Do NOT tap the old slug intelliops-bd — that resends the already-sent 25 Aug letter.

This send attaches Addendum No. 1 (the four remaining items + AIdeazz carve-out). They can bind it by signing the Word file or by accepting the same five clauses in a reply. Origination starts the same week they accept, not before.

Reuse existing deal 64302436100. Overlay commission, not a job. Full write-up: docs/selling/intelliops/.
